silvercat-summer-resort.body_height_method: idle 15 scalp/hair surface to supporting sole estimate excluding hat/ears, weapons and effects; retained source-pixel review estimate
silvercat-summer-resort.coordinate_convention: foot is [x,y] local to original atlas frames[index].rect, in source pixel-edge coordinates rounded to 0.5 px. A visible supporting sole, or midpoint of supporting soles; never automatic bbox center or hand/weapon/effect/tail bottom.
silvercat-summer-resort.mapping: capture_anchor=[111+192*(index%8),238+218*(index//8)]; capture_scale=112/idle_body_height; source_local=bbox_bottom_center+(capture_foot-capture_anchor)/capture_scale. Selected obscured crouch soles were cross-checked directly on original sheet.
silvercat-summer-resort.uncertainty: Manual static-image approximations; 0.5 px is storage precision, not accuracy. Foot uncertainty typically +/-5 source px, obscured crouch or uncertain support +/-8 px or more. Standing-equivalent body height uncertainty +/-15 px or more. Per-action shared values reflect visually similar head size; do not stretch crouches to standing height. Runtime playback remains to be checked.
